# Known AI-generated images (benchmark set)

Drop images here that you KNOW were AI-generated (ChatGPT/DALL·E,
Midjourney, Gemini, Stable Diffusion, etc.). They are used by

    cd backend && py -m eval.image_model_benchmark

to test which local detector model performs best on YOUR real-world cases.
Any .png / .jpg / .jpeg / .webp / .bmp file works.
